name: Cyclops Lesion after ACL Reconstruction
definition: Localized anterior arthrofibrotic nodule after ACL reconstruction that can mechanically block terminal extension.

investigations.principle: MRI demonstrates a cyclops nodule when clinically suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Symptomatic mechanical block often requires arthroscopic excision.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu postoperative stambha phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Localized anterior arthrofibrotic nodule after ACL reconstruction that can mechanically block terminal extension.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
